text.description_html:
HES 12 Volt Compact Electric Strike

The 12 Volt Compact Electric Strike with #5 Faceplate is ideal of use with cylindrical locksets with wood frame installations. Offering up to 1/4 inch of horizontal adjustability, the V3 Electric Strike will fit cylindrical locksets with 1/2 inch to 5/8 inch latchbolts, in medium duty applications.

Features and Specifications of the 12 Volt Cylindrical Lock Electric Strike with #5 Faceplate:

  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Accommodates 1/2" – 5/8" cylindrical latchbolt (5/8" with 1/8" door gap)
  • Non-handed
  • Keeper shims for horizontal adjustment.
  • Static strength 1000 lbs.
  • Dynamic strength 50 ft-lbs.
  • Tested to endure 500,000 cycles.

Sold Individually.
